title: Circuit evaluation bound at test points
statement: Let $C$ be a finite arithmetic circuit on $n$ inputs, and let $u$ be any finite Boolean string. Form an input whose $i$th coordinate is one plus the value, in least-significant-bit-first convention, of the block of $|C|+4$ bits of $u$ starting at position $i(|C|+4)$; missing bits contribute nothing. Then the absolute value of the integer output of $C$ at this input is at most $2^{5(|C|+12)2^{|C|+12}}$, where $|C|$ denotes the number of gates.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a finite arithmetic circuit on $n$ inputs
